title: Example 3 – Timer: PWM und Puls (Compare), Tastendauer (Capture)
description: 4 LEDs an Port L, 4 Taster an Port M. LED1 = PWM von Timer0 (T0CCP0), LED2 = Puls von Timer1 (T1CCP0), Taste 0 an T2CCP0 (Timer2 Capture), UART0
_pins: LED1/LED2 und Taste 0 liegen auf CCP-Pins (GPIOPCTL = 3): PL4 = T0CCP0, PL6 = T1CCP0, PM0 = T2CCP0

uart.label: UART0 (PA0 RX / PA1 TX) – Stufe und Tastendauer

solution.label: Demo (Timer0 PWM, Timer1 Puls, Timer2 Capture)

scope._timebaseUs: 20 ms/div: ca. 6 PWM-Perioden; für den 1-s-Puls von LED2 in der Web-Konsole 200 ms/div wählen
